INSERT INTO limits (
                guild_id,
                limit_name,
                limit_type,
                limit_action,
                limit_per,
                limit_time,
                limit_timeout_duration
            )
            VALUES (
                $1,
                $2,
                $3,
                $4,
                $5,
                make_interval(secs => $6),
                CASE WHEN $7::double precision IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE make_interval(secs => $7) END
            )
